fbx_export_corrections.fbx_unit_fix_note: Blender's FBX exporter writes the mesh and the bone rest hierarchy in centimetres but writes the bone animation curves in metres.  The location curves of every pose bone are multiplied by this factor while the files are written, so Unreal reads the animated translations in centimetres.  The master blend is not touched.
fbx_export_corrections.fbx_yaw_note: The armature is turned by this angle around Z while the files are written, so the Operative faces +X in Unreal (Blender faces -Y).  The master blend keeps the original orientation.
fbx_export_corrections.applies_to: export time only, the master blend keeps metres and -Y
